_comment: Where each vendored app came from, and which commit of it this tree holds.
The SOURCE OF TRUTH for these three apps is this repository. The standalone
repositories named below are PUBLISH TARGETS: tools/publish-app pushes a
finished change out to one of them. Editing a standalone repo directly and
expecting the platform to pick it up is the one workflow this layout does not
support -- the next publish would overwrite it.
`commit` is the commit of the standalone repo each directory was last synced
with, in either direction. tools/publish-app updates it after a successful
